text:
Sam Rivera: FYI: Cloud alert — us-west3 preemptible reclaim spiked to ~60% over the last 5m. GPU queue depth x3, user-facing latency + tail. Anyone oncall?
incidentbot: Paging eng-oncall -> @Marco Li (priority: high, rule: preemptible_reclaim_5m)
Marco Li: On it. What are the exact numbers and affected pools?
Anya Patel: Metrics snapshot: `preemptible_reclaims_5m = 0.62`, queued_gpus = 127 (baseline ~40). Affected: gpu-ephemeral-usw3 and batch-evictables-usw3.
Kai Nguyen: If reclaim stays >50% we should avoid routing more jobs to the zone. Can we provision overflow in a different region?
Anya Patel: I'm provisioning an ephemeral overflow pool in us-west1-b (8x A10g preemptible nodes) and will attach it to `gpu-fabric-evictable-group`. Starting now.
Sam Rivera: Good. Do staged traffic shift: 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m observation windows. No full cutover unless queues drop.
Marco Li: Agree. I'll patch smartrouter to add a temporary weight for `overflow-usw1`. Patch command: ```bash
curl -X PATCH https://router.internal/api/v1/routes/traffic-shift \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"route":"gpu-infer","stages":[{"target":"overflow-usw1","weight":0.25,"wait":300},{"target":"overflow-usw1","weight":0.5,"wait":300},{"target":"overflow-usw1","weight":1.0,"wait":600}]}'\n```
Anya Patel: Provision done — nodes provisioned: 8/8, kube labels applied, healthchecks passing. Joining pool now.
deploy-bot: route update applied for `gpu-infer` -> staged weights 25%/50%/100% (initiated by Marco Li)
Kai Nguyen: Cost note: provisional estimate ~\$7k/day at current utilization. Recommend `auto_shutdown: 6h` on pool and billing alert scope `team:infra`. I'll create the billing rule now.
Sam Rivera: Also propose we increase the incident paging threshold for preemptible noise: raise immediate-page threshold from 50% -> 65% reclaim for 5m, and add a 10m cooldown to reduce flapping. Thoughts?
pagerbot: Proposed change logged -> change_id:chg-2026-0601-01. Voting window 10m.
Marco Li: +1 to threshold change and cooldown. Makes sense given noisy preemptible behavior. I'll update alert rule and silence noisy probes temporarily.
Anya Patel: Updated alert: `preemptible_reclaim_alert` now fires at 0.65 over 5m. Added `cooldown_minutes: 10`. Also added a temporary suppression for low-severity flapping alerts.
Marco Li: Staged traffic at 25% — queue depth dropped from 127 -> 85 in 7m. Moving to 50% now.
Sam Rivera: Good. Keep an eye on tail latency (p95/p99). If anything spikes, rollback weight to 0.25 immediately.
Marco Li: 50% stable. p95 ok, p99 marginally improved. I'll hold for another 10m then move to 100% if stable.
Anya Patel: Reminder before full rollback drain steps: run `./scripts/drain-evictables --target overflow-usw1 --dry-run` then `--apply` when ready.
Kai Nguyen: I'll file a cost postmortem and tag resources: `incident:ephemeral-overflow-1891234567`. Also set alert to auto-notify finance if pool >4h.
incidentbot: Incident assigned -> owner: Marco Li. Escalation rules updated per change_id:chg-2026-0601-01.
Sam Rivera: I'm handing over now — logging off at 15:30Z. Marco, please monitor until queue <45 for 15m and close.
Marco Li: Taking over. Closing criteria noted. I'll also capture exact steps in runbook.
deploy-bot: route weights reverted to normal once Marco closes (manual).
Sam Rivera: Thanks all :thumbsup:
Marco Li: Closing checklist: queue <45 for 15m, no reclaim >40% for 30m, cost ticket opened. Will close thread when met.
Anya Patel: All set from infra side.
Kai Nguyen: Cost ticket created: FIN-4829 (link in ticketing).
Marco Li: Queue stabilized at 39 for 20m, reclaim at 0.18. Rolling back staged route and deprovisioning overflow pool in 10m.
deploy-bot: deprovision started for `overflow-usw1` (initiated by Marco Li)
Marco Li: Overflow deprovision complete. Incident closed.
incidentbot: Incident closed and summary archived.
Sam Rivera: Nice work everyone.
